settings.title: How we reach you
settings.sub: Your inbox keeps every alert, reminder and notice. Choose which ones also come by email.
settings.loadFailed: Your notification settings did not load.
settings.saveFailed: Your change was not saved. Try again.
settings.alertsSub: Alerts follow your saved searches. Each search has its own settings.
settings.alertsNone: You have no saved searches yet. Alerts start once you save one.
settings.alertsLoadFailed: Your saved searches did not load.
settings.alertsProNote: Pro can get alerts as they arrive.

rows.alertSub: New jobs for your saved searches.
rows.reminderSub: Follow-ups, interview dates and deadlines you saved.
rows.invitationSub: Messages from employers who invite you to apply.

settings.tipsOffNote: Tips and reminders are off, so none are sent.
settings.emailUnavailable: Add an email address to your account to get messages by email.
settings.lockedNote: Account, security and billing messages are always sent.
settings.quietNote: Alerts and tips are not sent between {start} and {end} your time.

confirmSub.alerts: This stops every job alert email, instant alerts and summaries alike. Your %BRAND% inbox still shows new alerts. You can turn email back on in Settings at any time.
confirmSub.reminders: Your %BRAND% inbox still shows reminders. You can turn email back on in Settings at any time.
confirmSub.tips: Tips and reminders stop everywhere, in your %BRAND% inbox too. You can turn them back on in Settings at any time.
confirmSub.marketing: You'll stop getting product news by email. Emails about your account still arrive.
confirmSub.anon: We'll stop sending job alert emails to this address.

doneSub.alerts: We won't send you job alert emails any more, instant or summaries. An email that was already on its way may still arrive.
doneSub.reminders: We won't send you reminder emails any more. An email that was already on its way may still arrive.
doneSub.tips: Tips and reminders are off, by email and in your inbox. An email that was already on its way may still arrive.
doneSub.marketing: We won't send you product news emails any more. An email that was already on its way may still arrive.
doneSub.anon: We won't send job alert emails to this address any more. An email that was already on its way may still arrive.

unsubscribe.invalidSub: It may be incomplete or from another site. Sign in to change your emails in Settings.
unsubscribe.previewFailed: We couldn't check this link just now. Your emails have not changed.
unsubscribe.surveyFailed: Your answer was not sent. Try again.
